title: Forge load balancer
description: The site of a Laravel Forge load balancer for `forge load-balancer apply`. Each node is an environment of the project: the site file <environment>/site.json, next to this file, gives its server, domain, aliases and wildcards.

server.description: Load balancer name (exact match) or ID.

method.description: Balancing method. Forge does not report it: apply sets it with the nodes.

nodes.description: The servers that the load balancer sends traffic to, one per environment.

environment.description: Folder of the site file of the node, next to this file, e.g. production for production/site.json.

port.description: Port of the site on its server.

weight.description: Share of the traffic of the node.

backup.description: Send traffic to the node only when the other nodes are down.

down.description: Send no traffic to the node.
